summary: PLDT Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026, attaching the SEC Form 17-C disclosure it filed with the Philippine Stock Exchange and Philippine SEC regarding the separation of an officer of the Company. The Philippine filing is the local equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report. No name, title, effective date, successor, or reason for the departure is stated in the excerpt, and no board recommendation or advisor appears. Because an abrupt officer separation is itself the disclosed event, it classifies as a management change; governance impact and any successor announcement are the items to watch.
